info.title: API.SH: Allabolag
info.description: The Allabolag API from API.SH: public Allabolag data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Swedish companies most recently declared bankrupt or put into liquidation, newest first: company, org number, type, address, county, industry, foundation and liquidation dates, status (e.g. bankruptcy started), last revenue and profit, and the appointed administrator's name and role, plus monthly counts. 25 a page, up to 1,000 pages. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/allabolag-bankruptcies

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

get.summary: Swedish company profile, board and accounts
get.description:
One Swedish company by organisation number: registration and status, company type, purpose, contact details and addresses, industries and NACE codes, share capital, VAT/F-tax/payroll registration, officers and board grouped by role (name and role), chairman, managing director, signatory rules, up to five years of annual accounts (income statement, balance sheet and key ratios as named figures in thousand SEK, plus every source code) for the company and its group, group structure and parent, annual report periods, registry announcements, business units, trademarks and related companies, with the site's record in `raw`. Birth dates of people are left out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/allabolag-company

get.description:
Search for persons (company officers, board members) on Allabolag.se by name. Returns name, birth date, age, address, and their company roles. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/allabolag-person-search

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Swedish companies by name, organisation number or industry (a query that names an industry, e.g. Bilar, lists that industry and returns `industry_match`), with county, municipality and post-town filters and revenue or employee sorts. Each company has org number, name, legal name, type, phone, email, homepage, addresses, county, municipality, coordinates, industries, NACE codes, revenue and profit (thousand SEK), employees, foundation date, status and the listed contact role. `facets` lists filter values with counts; page 1 also has exact `name_matches` and `inactive_companies`. 25 a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/allabolag-search

parameters.description: Company name, organisation number or industry.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), revenueDesc, revenueAsc, numEmployeesDesc or numEmployeesAsc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

get.summary: Sweden's top companies by employees, turnover and age
get.description:
Allabolag's top lists: Swedish companies with the most employees, the highest turnover and profit (thousand SEK) and the oldest, each with rank, org number, name and value.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/allabolag-top-lists

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
